title: 99% Of Banana Exports Are One Cavendish Clone
hook: Nearly every exported banana is the same vulnerable variety.
closing: One shared weakness can threaten the banana most shoppers expect.
question: Have you tried another banana variety?

segments.say: Cavendish makes up 99% of banana exports. One variety dominates what shoppers can buy.
More than 1,000 banana varieties exist. Most never reach the export market.
The disease now spans 3 continents. Identical plants give it the same weakness to exploit.
